summary.headline: Moon in the Planetary Terms
summary.text: Chapter XXVI interprets the Moon in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury, describing effects on marriage, offspring, wealth, trade, anger, injury, writing, and honor. The preceding lines also discuss Mercury in its domicile or fall and the effects of planetary aspects.
